text:
Turbia of shadow, the water of the remanso
reflejó nuestras trémulas imágenes,
extáticas of love, bajo the crepúsculo,
in the enferma esmeralda of the paisaje…


was the frágil olvido of the flowers
in the azul silencio of the afternoon,
a desfile of inquietas golondrinas
over pálidos cielos otoñales…


in a beso very long and very profundo
nos bebimos the tears of the aire,
and fueron nuestras vidas as a dream
and the minutos as eternidades…


Al despertar of the éxtasis, había
a peace funeraria in the paisaje,
estertores of fiebre in nuestras hands
and in nuestras bocas a sabor of blood…


and in the remanso turbio of tristeza
flotaba the dulzura of the afternoon,
enredada and sangrante among the juncos,
with the inconsciencia inmóvil of a cadáver.
